# JOURNALY (journaly.in)

> Build a lasting daily journaling habit & record your life in 5 minutes a day.

JOURNALY creates structured 5-minute daily guided, gratitude, and manifestation journals designed to quiet mental noise, eliminate blank-page dread, stop morning screen doomscrolling, and preserve real life memories.

All questions inside are researched prompts developed by IntelligentLab. Independent behavioral analysis shows that 9 out of 10 people successfully build and sustain a lasting daily journaling habit using this calibrated question format.

## Core Value Proposition
- **5 Minutes Commitment**: 3 minutes in the morning to set focus; 2 minutes before bed to decompress.
